title: createProject
responsibility: Creates app, library or game project files from admitted names and template inputs, preserving ordered writes and overwrite protection.

inputs.name: createProject.input
inputs.description: Provides the required project kind and name, with optional parent, dimension, and force fields. A non-empty parent prefixes the target directory; an omitted or empty parent uses the name, dimension is limited to 2d or 3d when truthy, and omitted dimension or force is passed through as undefined.

inputs.name: renderCreateProject.result
inputs.description: Provides the project kind, validated name, and write results to format. The kind and name supply the heading, and the write results supply the rendered file list.

outputs.name: createProject
outputs.description: Resolves to an object containing the input kind, validated name, and write results returned by writePlannedFiles. A rejection from template generation or either awaited filesystem step rejects the promise without rollback in this function.

outputs.name: renderCreateProject
outputs.description: Returns a creation heading followed by the formatted write list from renderFileList. The heading uses the result kind and name.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when input.dimension is truthy and is neither "2d" nor "3d"; its message is exactly "Dimension must be 2d or 3d.".

errors.name: Error("Dimension must be 2d or 3d.")
errors.description: Thrown before template generation when input.dimension is truthy and is neither "2d" nor "3d"; the message is exactly "Dimension must be 2d or 3d.".

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The call to validateProjectName rejects a name that fails project-name validation before template generation or filesystem work.

errors.name: Project file failure
errors.description: An error from template generation, parent creation, or planned-file writing rejects the returned promise. This function does not roll back writes completed before a later failure.
